'''Brian Kim''' (full name Brian Kim McCormick) is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with Avalon Artist Group.

==Biography==
Kim became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced recurring character {{OBP|Dana|SM041}}.
